name: Órgiva (Spain)
description: Vertically divided, the hoist white with the crowned municipal arms of Órgiva (bells, a lion and a chequy field), the fly divided diagonally green above and crimson below.
history: Municipal flag of Órgiva; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Órgiva arms — bells, lion and chequy
